summary: Plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition of cobalt oxide onto nanotextured p +n-Si devices enables efficient photoelectrochemical water oxidation and effective protection of Si from corrosion at high pH (pH 13.6). The study highlights the enhanced stability and performance of Si photoelectrodes through the engineering of the catalyst/semiconductor interface.
evidence: Plasma-enhanced atomic layer deposition of cobalt oxide onto nanotextured p +n-Si devices enables efficient photoelectrochemical water oxidation and effective protection of Si from corrosion at high pH (pH 13.6).
